preconditions.description: The number of strings in the list A is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in the list A is a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(f(L) for L in contiguous_sublists(A))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of f(L) for all nonempty contiguous sublists L of A.
f(L) is 1 if L is a stable list, and 0 otherwise.

postconditions.expression: is_stable(L) if and_only_if all(is_good_message(m) for m in SX(L))
postconditions.description: A list L is stable if and only if every message in SX(L) is good.
A message m is good if the number of its cyclic shifts in SX(L) is equal to the number of words in m.
